metadata.title: Indicated jump in SpaceX's stock would make Musk a trillionaire - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 day ago
Indicated jump in SpaceX's stock would make Musk a trillionaire
With SpaceX Class A shares recently trading around $177.20 on the Hyperliquid blockchain exchange, the value of the 849.5 million Class A shares Musk owns is now $35.85 billion more than at the $135 IPO pricing.
But Musk also owns 5.57 billion Class B shares. With 6.42 billion shares in total, the indicated 31.3% rise in SpaceX shares would boost the value of his total holdings by $270.86 billion. Based on a net worth of $971 billion as of June 11, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, the bump in SpaceX's stock alone would lift Musk's net worth to over $1.2 trillion.
Keep in mind Musk also owns over 717 million Tesla shares, according to an April filing, the Tesla's stock is up 0.7% in premarket trading.
